params.body:
## Why

Shane: "hoe beheerden dealers op vandaag hun eigen werknemers?" Through Instellingen, the garage sheet, second tab. That tab was the only way in, and until 18 September that screen was called "Mijn profiel" in the user menu, so the staff list was hidden behind a name that promised something else.

## What changed

- `ownuser.edit` accepts `?tab=2`, so the staff tab has an address of its own (the session fallback stays for a save that returns to the sheet).
- "Mijn profiel" carries one text link under the account details, for whoever may manage users: "Werknemers van je garage beheren" → the garage sheet on the Werknemers tab. A seller without that right does not see it, so nobody is sent to a screen that refuses him.
- Rule R P2-2.15 and the four languages.

## Not in this PR

A menu entry "Werknemers" under Instellingen. The menu is data (`menus` plus the rights per role), so it needs a migration that touches every dealer's menu and a decision on which roles see it. Worth doing, separately.

## Tests

`ProfileOwnDetailsTest` gained "who may manage users finds the staff list from his profile". Run of `SmokeTest|ProfileOwnDetailsTest|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|RulesSources|LanguageParity|CompiledViews`: 294 tests, 600 assertions, one pre-existing incomplete. `php bin/rules-sources`: Geen problemen.
params.title: The staff list is a destination: a link from the profile and an addressable tab
